company_description: DEUTZ Aktiengesellschaft engages in the development, production, distribution, maintenance, and servicing of diesel and gas engines in Germany, Rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and the United States. It operates through five segments: Services, Engines, NewTech, Energy, and Defense & Other. The company offers engine finder, diesel engines, gas and gasoline engines, and hydrogen engines, as well as electric technology, such as electric systems, high voltage battery systems, and powertree products.
